state: Basketball game: we are losing by 3 points and there are 5 seconds left on the clock. We have possession of the ball.

route.instructions: What should we do on this last possession to give ourselves the best chance of winning?

criteria.three shot: Shoot a three-pointer: the only option that can tie the game with one possession
criteria.dunk: Go for a dunk: scores only 2 points, not enough to tie
criteria.foul: Get fouled to shoot two free throws: scores at most 2 points, not enough to tie
